title: strict_spawn_class frees temp-allocator slices via delete — 134 'bad free' diagnostics on every odin test core run
evidence:
core/growth_test.odin:527-528: 
	parent := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(parent)
core/growth_test.odin:556-557: 
	size := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(size)
Runtime (`odin test core`, this worktree, both lines blamed to this PR's commit 9bf656d): 
        +++ bad free        @ 0x70D800040 [growth_test.odin:528:strict_spawn_class()]
        +++ bad free        @ 0x70D800048 [growth_test.odin:557:strict_spawn_class()]
— 67 occurrences per line, 134 total (plus only 2 pre-existing bad frees in health_test.odin:877/910).
detail: Slices are allocated from the temp arena but `defer delete` frees through context.allocator (slices don't record their allocator); the test runner's tracking allocator flags every free as bad — 134 lines per run, masking real diagnostics, and failing under ODIN_TEST_FAIL_ON_BAD_MEMORY=true.
recommended_fix: Allocate with the default allocator — make([]i32, n) — so make and defer delete both use context.allocator (the file's [dynamic] deletes are correct because dynamic arrays record their allocator).

title: New predicates re-inline i64 dist² math instead of the existing dist2 helper
evidence:
core/topology.odin:101-105 (pre-existing pinned metric): 
dist2 :: proc(a, b: [2]i32) -> i64 {
	dx := i64(a[0] - b[0])
	dy := i64(a[1] - b[1])
	return dx*dx + dy*dy
}
core/growth.odin:311 (new, growth_seed_sep_ok): 
		d := t.node_pos[i] - pos
		if i64(d[0])*i64(d[0]) + i64(d[1])*i64(d[1]) < d2 {
core/growth.odin:342 (new, growth_attach_radius_ok): 
	return i64(d[0])*i64(d[0]) + i64(d[1])*i64(d[1]) <= r2
(the same inline expression appears 5× in growth.odin and 5× in the new growth_test.odin audit code)
detail: The diff adds ten inline re-derivations of i64 dist² while dist2 is the project's pinned integer metric (arch §6.1). Pre-existing growth.odin siblings also inline it, so this is style-consistent — note-level.
recommended_fix: Call dist2(t.node_pos[i], pos) in growth_seed_sep_ok/growth_attach_radius_ok and the new test helpers; pure refactor with byte-identical arithmetic.
